sentences.en: A few years ago, I felt like I was stuck in a rut, so I decided to follow in the footsteps of the great American philosopher, Morgan Spurlock, and try something new for 30 days.

sentences.en: The idea is actually pretty simple. Think about something you've always wanted to add to your life and try it for the next 30 days.

sentences.en: There's a few things I learned while doing these 30-day challenges.

sentences.en: And I remember exactly where I was and what I was doing that day.

sentences.en: I also figured out that if you really want something badly enough, you can do anything for 30 days.

sentences.en: Have you ever wanted to write a novel? Every November, tens of thousands of people try to write their own 50,000-word novel, from scratch, in 30 days.
sentences.zh: 就是每天写1667个字要写一个月。所以我做到了。顺便说一下，秘密是除非在一天里你已经写完了1667个字，要不你就甭想睡觉。你可能被剥夺睡眠，

sentences.en: So I did. By the way, the secret is not to go to sleep until you've written your words for the day.

sentences.en: I learned that when I made small, sustainable changes, things I could keep doing, they were more likely to stick.

sentences.en: There's nothing wrong with big, crazy challenges.
sentences.zh: 所以我给大家提的问题是：大家还在等什么呀？

sentences.en: In fact, they're a ton of fun. But they're less likely to stick.
